mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_log_outbox ( order_id, user_id, payload, status, created_at, sent_at, retry_count, last_error, request_id ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{sentAt}, #{retryCount}, #{lastError}, #{requestId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, user_id, payload, status, created_at, sent_at, retry_count, last_error FROM order_log_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_log_outbox SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, status = CASE WHEN retry_count >= #{maxRetry} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE status END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, user_id, payload, status, created_at, sent_at, retry_count, last_error FROM order_log_outbox WHERE status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_log_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED'
